Cliply FFprobe source-build evaluation (not production-selected)

FFprobe is part of FFmpeg, https://ffmpeg.org/.
This recipe uses the unmodified FFmpeg n8.1 source at commit
9047fa1b084f76b1b4d065af2d743df1b40dfb56. Copyright remains with the
FFmpeg authors and other authors identified in the individual source files.

The evaluated configuration reports GNU Lesser General Public License
version 2.1 or later. See COPYING.LGPLv2.1 and upstream LICENSE.md.
The full source archive preserves all original copyright notices and other
license terms, including MIT/X11/BSD notices and optional unused GPL sources.
The presence of those optional sources does not enable GPL components.

This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.
Cliply has not modified libavcodec/jfdctfst.c, jfdctint_template.c or jrevdct.c
from the pinned FFmpeg revision. Upstream adaptations and their notices are
preserved in those files; complete copies accompany the source packet.

No external codec libraries are enabled. This does not mean there are no
operating-system or compiler-runtime dependencies. The platform build record
identifies the toolchain, final configuration and actual library imports.

The evaluated Linux distribution includes GCC-RUNTIME-NOTICES.txt (including
the GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1), COPYING.GPLv3 and GLIBC-NOTICES.txt.
These preserve the exact Ubuntu package notices for the recorded compiler and
runtime inputs. The source packet records their hashes and exact source-package
versions/locations in third-party/ffprobe/runtime-notices.json. Shared operating-
system libraries are supplied by the OS, not copied into this distribution.

The evaluated Windows distribution includes GCC-RUNTIME-EXCEPTION.txt,
COPYING.GPLv3, COPYING.GPLv2, MINGW-ZPL.txt, MINGW-RUNTIME-NOTICES.txt,
MINGW-NOTICES.txt, MINGW-DDK-NOTICES.txt and WINPTHREADS-NOTICES.txt.
These preserve the captured GCC, MinGW-w64 and winpthreads package notices,
including notices for optional toolchain components. Their inclusion does not
enable optional GPL components in FFprobe. The exact package versions, notice
hashes, static thread-runtime archive identity and versioned source-package
locations are recorded in the source packet. Shared Windows/UCRT system DLLs
are supplied by the OS and are not redistributed with this helper.

There is no warranty; the applicable license texts and source notices govern.
The corresponding-source packet includes the complete unmodified source,
build recipe, configuration, toolchain identity and reproduction instructions.
Future binary distributions must provide this notice, the applicable license
text and the verified matching source packet alongside the new release asset.
No source asset or binary is published by these evaluation scripts.
The accompanying Cliply build/packaging scripts remain GPL-3.0-only; their
license is included separately. This does not change FFprobe's build license.
